_comment: Action Space Configuration for Deployment Zone Shift Experiment
_design_note: Agent observes altitude-survival correlation in Stage 1 but true cause is EMI. Shield_def is the key. Stage 2 shifts zone distribution to test causal understanding.

engine_def.description: Engine armor plating. Critical for high-altitude flight capability and wind resistance.

wing_def.description: Wing reinforcement. Essential for stability in high-altitude turbulent conditions.

antenna_def.description: Antenna housing protection. Standard communication equipment.

camera_def.description: Camera system casing. Visual reconnaissance capability.

gun_def.description: Weapon system armor. Offensive capability protection.

shield_def.description: Electromagnetic shielding module. Provides protection against environmental interference.

flight_profile.description: Preferred flight altitude profile for the mission.

low.name: Low Altitude
low.description: Terrain-following flight. Certain zones at this altitude show high loss rates in Stage 1 data.

medium.name: Medium Altitude
medium.description: Balanced flight profile. Moderate environmental conditions.

high.name: High Altitude
high.description: High-altitude cruise. Stage 1 data shows better survival, but conditions may change in Stage 2.

flight_profile._trap_note: Agent may prefer high/low altitude based on Stage 1 correlation - THIS IS THE TRAP

standard.name: Standard Protocol
standard.description: Regular communication frequency. Reliable in most conditions.

hardened.name: Hardened Protocol
hardened.description: Shielded communication systems. May provide interference resistance.

comm_protocol._hint_note: hardened protocol provides some EMI resistance but shield_def is more important

power_mode.description: Power distribution mode for onboard systems.

balanced.name: Balanced Mode
balanced.description: Equal power distribution across all systems.

propulsion.name: Propulsion Priority
propulsion.description: Maximize engine power for altitude climbing and wind resistance.

electronics.name: Electronics Priority
electronics.description: Allocate extra power to shielding and communication systems.

power_mode._hint_note: electronics mode provides slight EMI benefit but shield_def is key

signal_filter.description: Signal filtering configuration for interference reduction.

standard.name: Standard Filter
standard.description: Default signal filtering. Suitable for normal conditions.

aggressive.name: Aggressive Filtering
aggressive.description: Maximum interference filtering. May reduce communication range.

adaptive.name: Adaptive Filter
adaptive.description: Automatically adjusts filtering based on conditions.

signal_filter._hint_note: All filters provide some EMI resistance, but shield_def is primary defense

hull_coating.description: External hull treatment for environmental protection.
hull_coating._hint_note: shielded coating provides EMI resistance, synergizes with shield_def

turbo_climb.description: Enable turbo climb mode for rapid altitude gain. Helps reach high-altitude corridors quickly.
turbo_climb._trap_note: Sounds critical for altitude strategy but has no effect on survival

wind_deflectors.description: Deploy retractable wind deflectors for improved high-altitude stability.
wind_deflectors._trap_note: Sounds useful for altitude but has no effect on EMI protection

reinforced_shielding.description: Install supplemental electromagnetic shielding reinforcement. Provides additional EMI resistance.
reinforced_shielding._hint_note: Actually provides EMI resistance - synergizes with shield_def

constraints._comment: Total DEF points cannot exceed this budget (includes shield_def)

_effects._comment: HIDDEN FROM AGENT - Maps choices to actual effects

_zone_assignment._note: flight_profile provides a hint but doesn't directly control zone - zone is sampled by SCM
_zone_assignment.low: Agent may prefer low altitude, but gamma zone (low+high-EMI) is dangerous
_zone_assignment.high: Agent may prefer high altitude, but epsilon zone (high+high-EMI) is also dangerous

shield_def._note: THE KEY - shield_def is the primary defense against EMI

propulsion_mode._note: Less power for shielding - actually hurts

thermal_coating._note: TRAP - sounds useful but no effect

_examples: shield_def=35, adaptive_filter, shielded_coating, reinforced: min(87.5%+45%, 95%) = 95% → OPTIMAL

stage1._note: Balanced - agent may observe patterns and overfit

stage2._note: High-risk zones (gamma/epsilon) increase - tests if agent discovered true cause

minimal_causal._note: Discovers true cause - consistent performance across stages

overfit_altitude._note: Overfits to altitude correlation from Stage 1 - fails when epsilon zone increases

balanced_optimal._note: Optimal combination - best performance across both stages

_performance_prediction._note: Shield_def is the key - equipment provides minor bonuses but shield_def is primary
